rows: 1. **A raised designation opening a field of shelter.** `س م و` B005 supplies “name as raised designation,” while the doubled `ر ح م` supplies B001 “mercy and tenderness” and B003 “womb.” The packet places the designation before two intensive mercy-forms and later repeatedly names *al-Rahman*. 1. **Settled good descends as an operative separator.** `ب ر ك` B004 supplies fixed, growing good; `ن ز ل` B002, bringing down; `ف ر ق` B001/B015, distinguishing things and distinct aspects; and `ن ذ ر` B001, warning that awakens caution. The sequence joins stable surplus above to discriminating warning below. I infer that the descent enables distinctions to become actionable; the ayah therefore reads as the installation of an enduring criterion, not merely the delivery of a text.

Since the criterion is placed “upon” the servant so that he becomes a warner, I infer that obedient formation makes him a legible mark for the worlds. This activates an embodied, transmissive reading of `عبده` alongside owned servanthood.

1. **Sovereignty is demonstrated as unshared proportioning.** `م ل ك` B003 supplies dominion and B002 disposal; `ش ر ك` B001, partnership; `خ ل ق` B001, measuring/proportioning, with B002 originating; and `ق د ر` B005/B006, deliberative arrangement and fitting proportion. The denials of offspring and partner interrupt the two mentions of dominion before creation and doubled estimation. I infer that exact proportion is the visible operation proving indivisible rule; the ayah reads creation’s fit as an argument against delegated or inherited sovereignty.

1. **Manufactured gods are trapped inside the very dependency they are asked to master.** `ء خ ذ` B010 supplies making something for oneself; `خ ل ق` B002 supplies originating, while the active/passive reversal `يخلقون/يخلقون` makes the proposed makers into made objects; `م ل ك` B002 supplies disposal. I infer that inability to originate entails inability to dispose even of their own selves. The ayah reads as a causal dismantling of divinity, not a mere list of missing powers.

1. **The accusation performs the diversion it alleges.** `ك ف ر` B001/B003 supplies covering and rejection of truth; `ء ف ك` B001/B002, turning from proper direction and a truth-diverted lie; `ف ر ي` B003, fabricating a lie; and `ز و ر` B001/B002, deviation and false speech. The speech attributes fabrication and assistance, then is itself named `زورا`. I infer a mirrored reversal: their claim redirects attention from descent to human manufacture. The ayah reads `إفك` diagnostically of the accusers’ own directional act.

1. **An imagined textual supply chain.** **Lexical:** `س ط ر B001` is an aligned written row, `ك ت ب B001` is joining one thing to another, `م ل و B004` is dictating a written text, `ب ك ر B001` is early morning, and `ء ص ل B003` is evening after afternoon. **Structure:** the accusation joins inherited rows to self-procured writing and recurrent dictation at both ends of the day. **Role:** joining supplies compilation, dictation supplies replenishment, and the two time markers make the process continuous. **Abduction:** I infer that the speakers imagine a repeatable human production line, not one isolated act of plagiarism. **Reading change:** the ayah presents their theory as a mechanically maintained workflow whose visible routine will be opposed by the hidden knowledge named in 25:6.

1. **Ordinary circulation is the delivery infrastructure.** **Lexical:** `ر س ل B001` is being sent forth and released, `م ش ي B001` is walking and movement, `س و ق B005` is the marketplace, while `س و ق B001` is also driving forward. **Structure:** messenger, eating, walking, and markets form one movement chain; 25:9 then names the lost *sabil*, and 25:12 contrasts nearby human circulation with punishment perceptible from afar. **Role:** walking embeds the envoy in common space, the market supplies public circulation, and the dormant driving branch gives that space directional force. **Abduction:** I infer that bodily participation enables warning to travel through ordinary social routes. **Reading change:** what the objection treats as disqualification becomes the mechanism by which the mission reaches lived life.

1. **Desired casting is ominously reversed.** **Lexical:** `ل ق ي B005` is casting something where it is met. **Structure:** the passive wish that treasure be cast to the messenger is answered, exactly five ayat later in 25:13, by the passive casting of the rejecters into a constricted place. **Role:** the same branch links desired bestowal and imposed emplacement while reversing recipient and value. **Abduction:** I infer that insistence on externally cast material proof places the speakers inside a grammar of external disposal; the packet supplies the reversal, while that warning relation is my inference. **Reading change:** the request is no longer neutral fantasy but the first half of a passive-voice reversal in which the demanders become what is cast.

1. **Representations become impacts that disable a route.** **Lexical:** `ض ر ب B001` is making an impact, `م ث ل B008` is a representation or image, `ض ل ل B001` is going astray from an aim, and `ط و ع B003` is practical capacity. **Structure:** their portraits of the messenger in 25:7-8 are followed by loss and then inability; the causative sequence is reinforced by the command to look at how the portraits were made. **Role:** the image strikes cognition, straying bends orientation, and incapacity prevents route recovery. **Abduction:** I infer that repeated labels do causal work by substituting a manufactured representation for encounter. **Reading change:** the ayah diagnoses a representational mechanism that damages practical navigation, not merely a set of inaccurate comparisons.

1. **The requested display is corrected in scale and duration.** **Lexical:** `ب ر ك B004` is a fixed, growing good, `ج ن ن B003` is a tree-covered garden, `ج ر ي B006` is an ongoing provision or grant, and `ق ص ر B005` is an enclosed monumental building. **Structure:** the singular garden demanded in 25:8 expands here into plural gardens, continuous rivers, and palaces; 25:15 then relocates comparison to the garden of permanence. **Role:** blessing stabilizes growth, flow makes provision continuous, and the palace supplies bounded habitation. **Abduction:** I infer that the conditional abundance demonstrates unconstrained capacity while postponing the decisive valuation to an enduring endpoint. **Reading change:** the fixed ayah is not merely a richer counteroffer; it corrects the demander's cramped scale and immediate time horizon.

1. **Preparedness collapses the distance of denial.** **Lexical:** `ع ت د B001` is what is prepared and present, and `س ع ر B001` is fire kindling and blazing. **Structure:** repeated declarations of falsehood bracket the repeated Hour, but the response shifts from their future-denial to an already prepared blaze; in 25:12 that blaze perceives them from a far place. **Role:** preparedness makes the threatened consequence presently ready, while blazing gives readiness active intensity. **Abduction:** I infer that the ayah counters temporal dismissal by presenting the future event as an existing readiness. **Reading change:** denial of the Hour becomes a failure to perceive present preparation, not simply disbelief in a remote date.

1. **Detection precedes confinement.** **Lexical:** `ر ء ي B004` is mutual visibility and facing, `ب ع د B001` is remoteness, `س م ع B011` is hearing without reaching, `غ ي ظ B001` is pent-up anger in the chest, and `ز ف ر B002` is heavy breath and harsh sound. **Structure:** sight travels from the blaze toward them while sound travels back toward them across distance; 25:13 then turns the far *makan* into a narrow *makan*. **Role:** remote sight detects, unreached hearing announces, and compressed anger becomes audible breath. **Abduction:** I infer that sensory capture begins before bodily arrival and prepares the later spatial capture. **Reading change:** punishment first appears as an inescapable relation across distance, not only as contact after entry.

1. **Spatial compression leaves only a blocked verbal exit.** **Lexical:** `ض ي ق B001` is narrowness against spaciousness, `ق ر ن B001` is joining and binding things together, `د ع و B001` is calling to draw near, and `ث ب ر B003` is restraint and blocking. **Structure:** casting is followed by a narrow place, bound bodies, and then a call; 25:14 multiplies the call without opening the space. **Role:** narrowness removes room, binding removes independent motion, and the ruin-call attempts to summon the only imaginable release while the dormant blocking branch denies it. **Abduction:** I infer that speech remains as the last form of movement after bodily movement is removed. **Reading change:** *thubur* reads as an attempted but blocked exit enacted by voice, not an abstract cry detached from the geometry.

1. **Numerical amplification exposes failed calling.** **Lexical:** `د ع و B001` is calling to draw near, `ث ب ر B002` is ruin and perdition, and `ك ث ر B001` is numerical abundance. **Structure:** call and ruin are repeated around the explicit contrast between one and many; 25:18 has the former allies disavow the callers, and 25:19 denies both diversion and help. **Role:** number intensifies the call's acknowledgement but cannot draw any rescuer near. **Abduction:** I infer that the imperative to multiply ruin-calls is ironic exposure of collapsed social efficacy. **Reading change:** the ayah is an arithmetic test showing that repetition cannot convert a severed relation into rescue.

1. **Good is evaluated by trajectory and endpoint.** **Lexical:** `خ ي ر B003` is choosing or seeking the better option, `و ق ي B002` is placing the self in protective caution, `ج ز ي B001` is recompense matching an act, and `ص ي ر B007` is a place of settling or destination. **Structure:** the question follows multiplied cries of ruin and contrasts them with a promised, guarded, matching destination; 25:20 later names patience inside the present test. **Role:** choice evaluates, caution governs the route, recompense links route to result, and destination stabilizes the comparison. **Abduction:** I infer that the two outcomes can be compared properly only by where their practices become settled. **Reading change:** the rhetorical question becomes a decision model in which protective conduct is a path toward a fitting end.

1. **Legitimate asking answers an offered commitment.** **Lexical:** `ش ي ء B001` includes willing toward a thing, `و ع د B001` is a spoken promise that opens expectation, `س ء ل B002` is the sought request, and `ر ب ب B002` is nurture and completion. **Structure:** their willing occurs inside permanence and is followed by a promise described as asked; 25:21 contrasts this with a demand that angels descend or the Lord be seen on the demanders' terms. **Role:** promise opens expectation, asking receives what was opened, and lordly nurture brings it to completion. **Abduction:** I infer that this asking is authorized responsiveness rather than leverage imposed on the giver. **Reading change:** *mas'ulan* makes the promise relationally accessible and fulfillable, sharply different from coercive proof-demand.

1. **The gathering is a causal audit of misdirection.** **Lexical:** `ح ش ر B001` is gathering and driving a group to a destination, `ع ب د B003` is worship and submissive obedience, `ض ل ل B001` is straying from guidance and aim, and `س ب ل B001` is an extended traversed way. **Structure:** worshipped and worshippers are driven into one scene, then the repeated root alternates causative "you misled" with intransitive "they strayed." **Role:** gathering makes all candidate agents present, the verbal alternation distinguishes imposed causation from self-navigation, and the way supplies the tested domain. **Abduction:** I infer that the question partitions responsibility rather than requesting unknown information. **Reading change:** the ayah becomes a tribunal over how a path was lost, not merely a scene of collective assembly.

1. **Experience replaces unsupported assertion.** **Lexical:** `ص ر ف B001` is turning back or diverting, `ن ص ر B001` is aid that makes someone prevail, and `ذ و ق B002` is experiencing and testing something. **Structure:** the worshipped beings first invalidate what their worshippers say; inability to divert or obtain aid follows, and tasted punishment then replaces speech with direct experience. **Role:** diversion would alter the trajectory, aid would overcome it, and tasting supplies an internal test when both external mechanisms fail. **Abduction:** I infer that a claim deprived of its represented allies loses performative leverage and is corrected by encounter. **Reading change:** the ayah shifts adjudication from what is said to what must be undergone and tested.

1. **Ordinary social adjacency is the assay medium.** **Lexical:** `ب ع ض B001` is parting a thing into portions, `ف ت ن B001` is assaying by trial, `ص ب ر B001` is self-restraint from panic, and `ب ص ر B002` is inner sight. **Structure:** food, walking, and markets repeat the objection in 25:7, but are now followed by reciprocal "some of you for others," a question about restraint, and inward seeing. **Role:** partition creates distinct social positions, contact between them performs the assay, restraint governs the response, and inner sight evaluates what appearance hides. **Abduction:** I infer that messenger ordinariness is deliberately retained because embodied social contact makes the test possible. **Reading change:** common bodily life is not incidental to mission; it is the designed apparatus through which responses are revealed.

1. **The demand for sight attempts to control the encounter.** **Lexical:** `ل ق ي B004` is two things coming face to face, `ك ب ر B006` is grandeur and self-magnification, `ن ف س B014` is self-regard and resolve, and `ع ت و B001` is insolent overstepping against obedience. **Structure:** lack of expectation for meeting is followed paradoxically by demands for angels or direct sight, then by doubled self-magnification and doubled overstepping; 25:22 grants sight of angels but reverses its value. **Role:** meeting names reciprocal encounter, while self-regard and overstepping try to dictate its terms. **Abduction:** I infer that the demand is not openness to evidence but an assertion that revelation must enter the demanders' preferred visual regime. **Reading change:** their request becomes an act of rank-making by the self rather than a neutral search for certainty.

1. **A demanded vision ends in a failed verbal enclosure.** **Lexical:** `ب ش ر B005` is face-brightening tidings, `ج ر م B003` is earning and causing something to be incurred, and `ح ج ر B001` is keeping back by enclosure. **Structure:** 25:21's requested angelic sight occurs, but without brightening news; the speakers then repeat the enclosure root as an utterance. **Role:** incurred action explains why vision has changed valence, and doubled enclosure is an attempted speech-barrier against what has arrived. **Abduction:** I infer that the phrase tries too late to perform verbally the protection that their earlier demand removed. **Reading change:** the ayah is not only adverse angelic appearance; it is the collapse of a self-made boundary at the moment desired visibility becomes unavoidable.

1. **Review reveals apparent work as unbound matter.** **Lexical:** `ق د م B004` is beforeward advance, `ع م ل B001` is intentional doing and work, `ه ب و B002` is fine scattered dust motes, and `ن ث ر B001` is scattering a thing apart. **Structure:** deliberate advance meets the doubled work root, after which a state-change converts the product into motes already described as scattered. **Role:** advance performs inspection, intentional work names human assembly, and the paired material images reverse assembly into de-cohesion. **Abduction:** I infer that the works lacked a valid binding relation to their intended end, so encounter exposes rather than arbitrarily creates their fragility. **Reading change:** the scene becomes a forensic material test of work's cohesion, not simple deletion of a moral ledger.

1. **Companionship becomes habitat.** **Lexical:** `ص ح ب B001` is companionship and close association, `ج ن ن B008` is protective cover, `ق ر ر B003` is settling and remaining fixed, and `ق ي ل B002` is midday sleep and resting-place. **Structure:** the fixed ayah follows scattered work in 25:23 and precedes the regret over an intimate companion in 25:28. **Role:** companionship names a durable social attachment, the garden protects it, and settled rest spatializes its security. **Abduction:** I infer that the abode is the externalized result of the attachment one has kept; the later destructive friend supplies the contrast. **Reading change:** the garden's good rest reads as right companionship made stable, not as a location detached from social formation.

1. **Disclosure arrives through layered covering.** **Lexical:** `ش ق ق B001` is splitting open, `س م و B004` is the overhead sky and cover, `غ م م B001` is covering and closing over, and `ن ز ل B004` is placing in proper order. **Structure:** an upper cover splits with another cover, while the passive descent is reinforced by its cognate verbal noun; this answers the angelic-descent demand of 25:21 without granting an uncontrolled unveiling. **Role:** splitting opens, cloud-cover mediates the opening, and ordered descent controls what crosses it. **Abduction:** I infer that concealment is made the medium of disclosure rather than simply removed. **Reading change:** the event reads as governed unveiling through nested covers, not the unmediated visibility the demanders tried to prescribe.

1. **Mercy and adjudicative cohesion are one sovereignty.** **Lexical:** `م ل ك B001` is strength and cohesion, `ح ق ق B002` is due obligation and deserved claim, `ر ح م B001` is mercy and tenderness, and `ع س ر B001` is difficulty and severity. **Structure:** true dominion is assigned directly to al-Rahman between the sky's opening in 25:25 and the wrongdoer's regret in 25:27. **Role:** dominion makes consequences cohere, due claim gives them normed fit, and mercy names the holder of that ordering. **Abduction:** I infer that protective mercy includes making deserved relations hold; the packet supplies the juxtaposition, not that theological arrow. **Reading change:** the hard day is not an exception interrupting mercy but the difficult face of mercy's truthful, cohesive rule for those who covered it.

1. **The hands indict the path they enacted.** **Lexical:** `ع ض ض B001` is holding with the teeth, `ي د ي B009` is the hands as one's act, `ء خ ذ B009` is taking on a path or character, and `س ب ل B001` is an extended traversed way. **Structure:** bodily self-biting precedes the wish to have taken a way; 25:28 repeats taking for the intimate friend, and 25:30 repeats it for treating the Qur'an as abandoned. **Role:** the hands embody prior agency, taking installs a course, and the way is the accumulated trajectory. **Abduction:** I infer that the person attacks the instruments of choice because the missed path was performed through acts, attachments, and handling of revelation. **Reading change:** regret becomes embodied self-testimony, not a merely verbal wish made after external misfortune.

1. **Cognitive intervention precedes material nullification.** **Lexical:** `ك ل ل B003` is totality and completeness, `م ث ل B011` is a lesson or sign, and `ت ب ر B001` is destruction, nullification, and breaking. **Structure:** repeated "each" pairs an example with an outcome for every case, while the destruction root is itself doubled. **Role:** the lesson offers a model capable of breaking the pattern cognitively; nullification breaks the failed pattern materially. **Abduction:** I infer that the first stage is a preventive intervention and that the second follows when the model does not reorganize conduct. **Reading change:** destruction appears after failed interpretive correction inside an exhaustive two-stage process, not as an unprepared event.

1. **Physical traversal fails because consequence is temporally deferred.** **Lexical:** `ق ر ي B001` is people gathered in a settlement, `م ط ر B002` is rainfall sent as punishment, `ر ء ي B001` is seeing by eye or insight, `ر ج و B004` is deferring something, and `ن ش ر B002` is reviving the dead. **Structure:** they come upon a collective site marked by punitive rain and are explicitly asked about seeing, yet the final clause shifts failure to their stance toward revival. **Role:** the settlement stores social evidence, sight makes it available, and deferral keeps its future implication from arriving in judgment. **Abduction:** I infer that "not expecting" operates as active postponement of what the visible site requires them to conclude. **Reading change:** their failure is not sensory absence but a temporal strategy that prevents seen history from becoming anticipated consequence.

1. **Mockery is defensive recategorization of a dispatched person.** **Lexical:** `ء خ ذ B010` is taking or making something for oneself, `ه ز ء B001` is mockery and derision, `ب ع ث B002` is dispatching and directing, and `ر س ل B002` is messenger and message. **Structure:** sight leads immediately to "taking" the seen person as an object of mockery, while the question repeats his true dispatched role; 25:42 admits that he nearly displaced their gods. **Role:** dispatch gives the person an externally assigned function, whereas taking manufactures a controllable social object that neutralizes that function. **Abduction:** I infer that derision manages the pressure of the message by replacing envoy with spectacle. **Reading change:** mockery becomes an appropriation mechanism, not a spontaneous emotional reaction to appearance.

1. **The confession reveals idolatry as effortful maintenance.** **Lexical:** `ك و د B002` is nearly doing an act, `ض ل ل B001` is straying from guidance and aim, `ص ب ر B001` is self-restraint from panic, and `ح ي ن B001` is the due occasion of a thing. **Structure:** the messenger almost dislodges them, their continued attachment depends on having held themselves upon the gods, and knowledge is delayed until the due occasion of seeing punishment. **Role:** nearness measures the pressure of correction, restraint maintains the inherited attachment, and due occasion reverses their path judgment. **Abduction:** I infer that a generally positive capacity, steadfast restraint, is here recruited to resist correction. **Reading change:** their allegiance is not passive inheritance; it is sustained cognitive labor whose success lasts only until a contrary encounter.

1. **Desire fills a regulatory void and becomes functional sovereignty.** **Lexical:** `ء ل ه B001` is worship and the worshipped one, `ه و ي B004` is desire and inclination of the self, `ه و ي B001` is air, void, and hollowness, and `و ك ل B006` is one who undertakes, suffices, and guards. **Structure:** making desire into a deity is followed by a question denying the messenger's guardianship; 25:44 then exposes failure of hearing and restraint, while 25:45-48 display stable external ordering. **Role:** inclination supplies commands, the void image names the absence of a stable norm, and guardianship names the control the messenger is not assigned to impose. **Abduction:** I infer that worship here means delegating decision authority to whatever fills the inner regulatory space. **Reading change:** desire is read as a governing function rather than merely a strong appetite.

1. **Straying is a broken guidance loop, not lack of raw sensation.** **Lexical:** `س م ع B003` is understanding and compliance, `ع ق ل B001` is understanding as restraint from ignorance, `ن ع م B005` is grazing livestock, and `ض ل ل B001` is straying from an aim. **Structure:** hearing and reasoning are negated before the livestock comparison; 25:48-49 then show winds, water, revived land, and livestock coupled reliably in one provisioning sequence. **Role:** compliant hearing receives a signal, reason restrains deviation, and livestock provide a model of organisms still coupled to environmental guidance. **Abduction:** I infer that humans are "more astray" because they can sever a sign-response loop that animals continue to inhabit. **Reading change:** the comparison becomes ecological and functional rather than a generic insult.

1. **Change makes an otherwise hidden relation legible.** **Lexical:** `م د د B001` is lengthwise drawing-out and extension, `ظ ل ل B001` is shade as covering, `س ك ن B001` is cessation of motion, and `د ل ل B001` is indicating a thing by a sign. **Structure:** extension is set against a counterfactual stillness, then the sun is assigned as indicator over the shade; 25:46 completes the movement by contraction. **Role:** extension generates variation, stillness supplies the unrealized control condition, and the sun lets the changing shade disclose its source relation. **Abduction:** I infer that motion is made pedagogically necessary because a fixed shade would not display the same measurable relation. **Reading change:** shade becomes a dynamic instrument of instruction, not only a physical comfort or visual object.

1. **Disappearance is controlled retrieval after expansion.** **Lexical:** `ق ب ض B006` is contraction after expansion, while `ي س ر B005` is light, pliant movement. **Structure:** the doubled grasp root follows the extended shade of 25:45 and moves it toward a stated endpoint; 25:47-49 then repeat contraction and release as sleep, waking, and land-revival. **Role:** contraction reverses extension, the endpoint prevents loss from appearing aimless, and ease marks continuity rather than rupture. **Abduction:** I infer that the shade's withdrawal models governance by reversible phases. **Reading change:** the grasp is a gentle recovery of what was spread, not annihilation after a temporary display.

1. **The daily cycle rehearses cutting and re-publication.** **Lexical:** `ل ب س B001` is covering by something worn, `ن و م B009` is stillness of things, `س ب ت B002` is cutting and removal, and `ن ش ر B001` is opening, spreading, and branching out. **Structure:** night covers, sleep interrupts activity, and the repeated making verb then turns day into spreading; 25:49 applies life after deadness to land. **Role:** clothing encloses, sleep stills, cutting suspends the active relation, and day releases it outward again. **Abduction:** I infer that the recurrent bodily cycle trains recognition of restoration after interruption. **Reading change:** daytime *nushur* is enacted re-publication into the world, not merely a label for waking hours.

1. **Mercy arrives through an advance-signal chain.** **Lexical:** `ر س ل B005` is succession in batches, `ب ش ر B007` is first visible signs or forerunners, `ي د ي B008` is "before the hands," `ر ح م B001` is mercy and tenderness, and `ط ه ر B004` is purifying water or medium. **Structure:** winds are dispatched as forerunners before mercy, then pure water descends; 25:49 names the recipients and 25:50 names mnemonic distribution. **Role:** successive winds announce, the before-hands construction establishes lead time, mercy names the approaching benefit, and purifying water executes it materially. **Abduction:** I infer that advance cues permit recognition and preparation before the benefit arrives. **Reading change:** mercy becomes a staged, publicly legible process rather than an unheralded result.

1. **Material circulation is designed to become cognitive return.** **Lexical:** `ص ر ف B002` is turning through states, `ذ ك ر B009` is reminder or admonition, `ء ب ي B001` is refusal and active withholding, and `ك ف ر B004` is covering over a favor. **Structure:** the water of 25:48-49 is repeatedly turned among recipients for remembrance, but the response moves through refusal into intensified covering; 25:51-52 then map distribution onto warning and textual struggle. **Role:** circulation varies the sign, remembrance internalizes it, refusal blocks uptake, and ingratitude covers the favor that supplied the evidence. **Abduction:** I infer that repeated variation is pedagogical redundancy intended to overcome habituation. **Reading change:** denial becomes failure to metabolize distributed benefit into recognition, not lack of available evidence.

1. **The counterfactual measures a centralized communication choice.** **Lexical:** `ب ع ث B002` is dispatching and directing, `ق ر ي B001` is people gathered in a settlement, `ك ل ل B003` is totality, and `ن ذ ر B001` is warning that awakens fear and caution. **Structure:** after water has been distributed among people, a warner in every settlement is presented as possible but unrealized; 25:52 instead assigns one great text-mediated striving, and 25:56 restates the messenger's paired mission. **Role:** settlement defines each local social node, totality scales the alternative, and dispatch would decentralize warning across all nodes. **Abduction:** I infer that the unrealized option highlights the burden and reach of the chosen communication architecture. **Reading change:** the ayah becomes a comparison of dissemination strategies, not merely a statement of unrestricted power.

1. **Revelatory exertion resists assimilation to the opponents' frame.** **Lexical:** `ط و ع B001` is pliant obedience and willing yielding, `ك ف ر B001` is covering and concealment, `ج ه د B001` is spending one's capacity under strain, and `ك ب ر B010` is greatness as hardship or heaviness. **Structure:** prohibition of yielding is followed by a doubled exertion root and an instrumental pronoun; 25:50-51 supply distributed reminder and warning, while 25:56-57 bound the mission to announcement without payment. **Role:** non-obedience preserves orientation, the covered opponents supply resistance, and capacity-under-strain sustains counter-address through the given medium. **Abduction:** I infer that "with it" makes revelation the instrument of a public and epistemic struggle. **Reading change:** great striving reads as sustained message-bearing under pressure rather than unspecified force.

1. **Productive release preserves difference through a boundary.** **Lexical:** `م ر ج B005` is looseness within its place, `ب ي ن B002` is the interval between things, `ح ج ر B001` is keeping back by enclosure, `ع ذ ب B001` is fresh sweet palatability, and `ء ج ج B003` is bitter, intensely salty water. **Structure:** two waters are released together, sharply qualified, and then separated by both an interval and doubled enclosure; 25:54 turns one water-source into differentiated kinship relations. **Role:** looseness permits active coexistence, qualities preserve distinct functions, and enclosure prevents destructive collapse into sameness. **Abduction:** I infer that the boundary enables rather than opposes the release. **Reading change:** the barrier becomes a productive governance mechanism, not a static wall between inert substances.

1. **The unsupported deity is sustained by its own worshipper.** **Lexical:** `ع ب د B003` is worship and submissive obedience, `ن ف ع B001` is benefit opposed to harm, `ض ر ر B001` is harm and adverse condition, and `ظ ه ر B006` is backing and support. **Structure:** the worshipped object is denied both beneficial and harmful agency, but the coverer is then named as backing against his Lord. **Role:** the two negations empty the object of causal leverage, while the final support branch relocates active force into the human adherent. **Abduction:** I infer that false worship survives because worshippers lend social and practical agency to what cannot act for them. **Reading change:** the idol's apparent power is exposed as manufactured human backing rather than power received from the object.

1. **The mission is bounded to a complete affective signal pair.** **Lexical:** `ر س ل B002` is messenger and message, `ب ش ر B005` is face-brightening tidings, and `ن ذ ر B001` is warning that awakens fear and caution. **Structure:** the restrictive construction follows 25:55's manufactured backing and precedes 25:57's refusal of payment; neither material support nor coercive control is assigned. **Role:** good news opens hopeful attraction, warning activates protective caution, and dispatch carries both without taking over the recipient's agency. **Abduction:** I infer that these opposed affects form a behaviorally complete orientation system within an intentionally limited office. **Reading change:** "only" narrows means while preserving a full two-directional call, rather than minimizing the mission.

1. **The only recompense is transformed recipient agency.** **Lexical:** `ء ج ر B001` is recompense for work, `ش ي ء B001` includes willing, `ء خ ذ B009` is taking on a path or character, and `س ب ل B001` is an extended traversed way. **Structure:** a total denial of requested wage is followed by an exception consisting not of payment but of a willing person's path-taking; 25:58 then commands reliance on one who needs no support. **Role:** wage names expected transfer to the worker, willing preserves recipient agency, and taking installs a course toward the Lord. **Abduction:** I infer that the messenger's only sought return is realized as change in another rather than wealth received from another. **Reading change:** the exception recodes compensation from material exchange into freely adopted trajectory.

1. **Reliable trusteeship includes full visibility of trailing liabilities.** **Lexical:** `و ك ل B002` is reliance and trust, `و ك ل B006` is the one who undertakes, suffices, and guards, `ذ ن ب B002` is the tail or rear consequence of a thing, `ك ف ي B001` is sufficing by taking care of a matter, and `خ ب ر B001` is tested inner knowledge. **Structure:** trust is placed in the living who does not die, then sufficiency and knowledge close the ayah after the no-wage mission of 25:57. **Role:** the trustee carries the matter, deathlessness removes expiration risk, trailing sins name liabilities that follow servants, and tested knowledge leaves none hidden. **Abduction:** I infer that reliance is accountable transfer to a fully informed, nonfailing keeper rather than passive ignorance. **Reading change:** trust and praise coexist with exact consequence-awareness.

1. **Completed authority rests on articulated relations and invites informed inquiry.** **Lexical:** `خ ل ق B001` is measuring and proportioning, `ب ي ن B002` is the interval between things, `س و ي B002` is internal straightness and sound completion, `س و ي B003` is rising and settling upon something, `ع ر ش B006` is a standing support of power, and `خ ب ر B001` is tested inner knowledge. **Structure:** proportioned heavens, earth, and between-space unfold across six days before settlement on the support of rule; the imperative to ask then points to expertise rather than bare assertion. **Role:** between-space articulates relations, sound completion closes formation, settlement establishes authority, and expertise makes that order investigable. **Abduction:** I infer that authority is evidenced by completed relational structure. **Reading change:** the cosmology becomes an evidentiary chain ending in warranted inquiry, not chronology followed by an unrelated title.

1. **Alternation supplies repeated opportunities for ethical recovery.** **Lexical:** `خ ل ف B001` is one thing coming after another and standing in its place, `خ ل ف B006` is alternation, `ذ ك ر B003` is bringing a thing to mind, and `ش ك ر B002` is being sustained by little and showing its effect. **Structure:** night and day replace one another, while willing is repeated before remembrance and gratitude; 25:63-67 then unfold walking, night worship, prayer, and balanced spending. **Role:** replacement renews the temporal field, willing opens uptake, remembrance restores what was missed, and gratitude makes received benefit visible in conduct. **Abduction:** I infer that every cycle offers another chance after prior omission. **Reading change:** alternation becomes ethical redundancy designed for repair, not simply a clockwork contrast.

1. **Gentleness is controlled social kinetics.** **Lexical:** `ه و ن B001` is calm dignity with gentleness, `خ ط ب B001` is directed address and verbal exchange, `ج ه ل B002` is rashness and unsettled folly, and `س ل م B004` is reconciliation and peace. **Structure:** a measured way of walking is followed by an attempted verbal engagement from agitated speakers and a peace-answer; 25:64-68 extend restraint into posture, fear, spending, and protected bounds. **Role:** gentle gait stabilizes bodily tempo, rash address tries to impose another tempo, and peace prevents that agitation from governing the exchange. **Abduction:** I infer that the reply is active de-escalation rather than weakness or mere politeness. **Reading change:** humility becomes the capacity to preserve one's motion and speech under social pressure.

1. **The middle is a load-bearing regime, not an arithmetic midpoint.** **Lexical:** `ن ف ق B002` is wealth going out as expenditure, `س ر ف B001` is overstepping the limit, `ق ت ر B001` is stinting and narrowing, `ب ي ن B011` is an intermediate state between two ends, and `ق و م B009` is support, mainstay, and subsistence. **Structure:** an outflow is bounded by two negations and then located between their extremes as *qawam*. **Role:** expenditure moves resources, excess breaches system limits, constriction starves the system, and the middle sustains it upright. **Abduction:** I infer that the correct measure is whatever preserves the function and subsistence of the whole, not equal distance from two quantities. **Reading change:** moderation becomes dynamic structural support.

1. **Three protected bounds become a path to encountered consequence.** **Lexical:** `ح ر م B003` is an inviolable precinct and protected bounds, `ن ف س B011` is the living soul-self, `ل ق ي B007` is what one meets of good or ill, and `ء ث م B001` is slowing and lagging from good. **Structure:** allegiance, protected life, and sexual relation are marked by repeated negation; the close shifts from doing to meeting. **Role:** inviolability unifies the prohibitions as boundaries, the living self identifies what one boundary protects, action crosses them, and meeting turns crossing into a future encounter. **Abduction:** I infer that transgression constructs the route on which its consequence comes face to face with the actor. **Reading change:** the list becomes one boundary system with a generated trajectory, not three unrelated rules.

1. **Chosen posture is inverted and made to cling.** **Lexical:** `ض ع ف B002` is adding an equal amount, `ق و م B013` is resurrection and rising of the Hour, `خ ل د B002` is leaning, clinging, and staying close, and `ه و ن B003` is humiliation through contempt. **Structure:** doubled punishment occurs at the rising, then adheres in humiliating permanence; within the window, 25:63 used `ه و ن B001` for calm dignity and 25:64 used `ق و م B002` for upright devotion. **Role:** doubling multiplies consequence, resurrection raises the actor, clinging fixes the result, and humiliation reverses gentle dignity. **Abduction:** I infer that cultivated or rejected posture hardens into an outcome with an opposite moral quality. **Reading change:** doubling is qualitative inversion as well as numerical increase.

1. **Sound work turns repeated return into a verified trajectory.** **Lexical:** `ع م ل B001` is intentional doing and work, and `ص ل ح B001` is soundness and rightness against corruption. The packet's only accepted `ت و ب` entry is causative `B003` (calling someone else to repent), so I do not force that branch onto these intransitive forms. **Structure:** three forms of the return root surround intentional, sound work and end with an explicit destination. **Role:** work supplies observable motion and soundness tests its direction; the repeated construction supplies initiation, continuation, and named course even where the inventory does not license a dormant branch. **Abduction:** I infer that the second clause verifies where the first return is actually going. **Reading change:** the apparent tautology becomes a distinction between beginning to turn and completing a God-directed return through repaired conduct.

1. **Dignity controls what receives validating presence and attention.** **Lexical:** `ش ه د B001` is presence with witnessing, `ز و ر B002` is falsehood and invalid speech, `م ر ر B001` is passing through, `ل غ و B001` is the thing set aside as not counting, and `ك ر م B001` is praiseworthy nobility. **Structure:** they deny falsehood their witnessing presence, then the doubled passing root moves them through noncounting speech without stopping. **Role:** witnessing could socially validate, noncounting speech solicits attention without worth, passing withholds capture, and nobility names the preserved agency. **Abduction:** I infer that ethical nonparticipation operates by controlling what is allowed to count, not by trying to suppress every utterance. **Reading change:** noble passage is an active attention filter rather than passive avoidance.

1. **The verse rejects inert collapse masquerading as response.** **Lexical:** `ذ ك ر B009` is reminder or admonition, `ء ي ي B003` is a visible sign, `خ ر ر B001` is falling with a rumbling drop, `ص م م B001` is loss of hearing and refusal to listen, and `ع م ي B002` is blindness of heart and insight. **Structure:** reminder by signs is followed by a negated fall qualified by deafness and blindness; 25:74 then turns eyes into settled family vision and asks for exemplary guidance. **Role:** reminder solicits active uptake, the fall supplies intense bodily reaction, and the two impairments expose reaction without perception. **Abduction:** I infer that physical intensity alone can imitate submission while leaving cognition closed. **Reading change:** the ayah criticizes performative collapse, not bodily reverence itself.

1. **Family becomes an ethical transmission network.** **Lexical:** `و ه ب B001` is giving a gift without exchange, `ذ ر ر B004` is gentle spreading emergence, `ق ر ر B002` is settled comfort of the eye, `ع ي ن B003` is the eye of watchful care, and `ء م م B009` is a leader, guide, or exemplar followed. **Structure:** after 25:73 rejects blind reception, the prayer asks for settled sight through spouses and descendants, then expands outward from household gift to public exemplar. **Role:** gift prevents ownership-claim, descendants spread the pattern, settled eyes make it perceptually stable, and exemplar lets protected people follow it. **Abduction:** I infer that domestic delight is sought as reproducible guidance rather than private possession. **Reading change:** the prayer asks for intergenerational and public propagation of right perception.

1. **Restrained passage is answered by elevation and life-giving address.** **Lexical:** `ج ز ي B001` is recompense matching an act, `غ ر ف B001` is lifting and taking up, `غ ر ف B002` is an upper chamber, `ص ب ر B001` is self-restraint from panic, `ل ق ي B011` is receiving or imparting speech, `ح ي ي B007` is greeting as wishing life and peace, and `س ل م B001` is soundness and safety. **Structure:** the disciplined responses of 25:72-74 culminate in matched elevation and a received greeting rather than false or idle speech. **Role:** patience holds the self, lifting spatializes its reward, and reception supplies affirmative social recognition. **Abduction:** I infer that their controlled speech-world is answered by speech that confers life and safety. **Reading change:** reward is communicative welcome as well as elevated habitation.

1. **Permanence is good because the settled relation is good.** **Lexical:** `خ ل د B001` is enduring permanence, `ح س ن B001` is goodness opposed to ugliness, `ق ر ر B003` is settling and remaining fixed, and `ق و م B006` is station and residence. **Structure:** abiding follows 25:75's elevation, greeting, and peace, then the paired place terms receive a positive verdict; 25:77 closes with a different kind of binding adherence. **Role:** permanence extends the condition, settlement fixes it, residence sustains it, and goodness evaluates the relational content already supplied. **Abduction:** I infer that duration alone is not the benefit; the welcomed and peaceful order makes duration desirable. **Reading change:** the abode is good as sustained relational stability, not merely because it never ends.

1. **Voluntary calling gives way to compulsory adherence when relation is denied.** **Lexical:** `ع ب ء B002` is lack of weight or regard, `ع ب ء B001` is a heavy burden, `د ع و B001` is calling to draw near, `ك ذ ب B002` is declaring false, and `ل ز م B001` is continuous accompaniment and fixed adherence. **Structure:** lack of regard is made conditional on their call, then denial leads prospectively to something that will adhere; the nearby 25:72 treats idle speech as not counting, while 25:74 models genuine prayer. **Role:** calling establishes relational weight, denial rejects that relation, and adherence supplies its involuntary replacement. **Abduction:** I infer that the close opposes chosen nearness through address to consequence that cannot be shaken off. **Reading change:** the final ayah presents relation as nonneutral: it is either cultivated through calling or imposed as binding aftermath.
